test_suite_name: V3 Godot Planet Capture Prepare and Authoritative Verification
description: Prepare a deterministic populated planet, test capture rollback, pause for an ordinary-player Godot UI attack, and verify conserved planet and unrelated player/corporation assets.

tests.name: Register ordinary Godot attacker
Register planet owner
Select a sector outside FedSpace without an existing planet

data.sql: SELECT MIN(s.sector_id) FROM sectors s WHERE s.sector_id > 10 AND s.sector_id < 900 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM planets p WHERE p.sector_id=s.sector_id);

tests.name: Fund player banks

data.sql: UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance=1000000 WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{godot_capture_owner_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE;

tests.name: Fund attacker bank independently

data.sql: UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance=54321 WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{godot_capture_attacker_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE;

tests.name: Set ordinary attacker alignment and location

data.sql: UPDATE players SET alignment=-501,sector_id=@{capture_sector},lastplanet=0 WHERE player_id=@{godot_capture_attacker_player_id};

tests.name: Set attacker ship combat resources

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=@{capture_sector},onplanet=FALSE,fighters=100 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{godot_capture_attacker_player_id});

tests.name: Set owner current sector before moving its active ship

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=@{capture_sector},lastplanet=0 WHERE player_id=@{godot_capture_owner_player_id};

tests.name: Set owner's ship location

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=@{capture_sector},onplanet=FALSE WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{godot_capture_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Pause only planetary growth in the disposable fixture for exact conservation

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=FALSE WHERE name='planet_growth';

tests.name: Verify deterministic fixture has planetary growth paused

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN enabled=FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM cron_tasks WHERE name='planet_growth';

tests.name: Pause corporation tax in the isolated fixture to protect unrelated-asset conservation

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=FALSE WHERE name='daily_corp_tax';

tests.name: Create corporation through ordinary owner workflow
Set exact unrelated corporation balance

data.sql: UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance=7777 WHERE owner_type='corp' AND owner_id=@{capture_corp_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE;

tests.name: Set unrelated owner personal balance after corporation setup

data.sql: UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance=87654 WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{godot_capture_owner_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE;

tests.name: Seed unrelated corporate sector defense outside the capture sector

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_assets(sector_id,owner_id,corporation_id,asset_type,quantity,offensive_setting,ttl) VALUES (@{capture_sector}+1,@{godot_capture_owner_player_id},@{capture_corp_id},1,17,0,0);

tests.name: Seed populated target and rollback target with conserved assets

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets(planet_id,sector_id,name,owner_id,owner_type,class,population,population_type,colonists_unassigned,colonists_ore,colonists_org,colonists_eq,colonists_weapons,fighters,ore_on_hand,organics_on_hand,equipment_on_hand,created_by,type) SELECT v.planet_id,@{capture_sector},v.name,@{godot_capture_owner_player_id},'player','M',1000,'COLONIST',600,100,100,100,100,50,123,234,345,@{admin_player_id},(SELECT MIN(planettypes_id) FROM planettypes) FROM (VALUES(977790,'Godot Capture Target'),(977791,'Godot Capture Rollback')) AS v(planet_id,name) ON CONFLICT(planet_id) DO UPDATE SET sector_id=EXCLUDED.sector_id,name=EXCLUDED.name,owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id,owner_type='player',population=1000,population_type='COLONIST',colonists_unassigned=600,colonists_ore=100,colonists_org=100,colonists_eq=100,colonists_weapons=100,fighters=50,ore_on_hand=123,organics_on_hand=234,equipment_on_hand=345;

tests.name: Seed target citadel treasuries

data.sql: INSERT INTO citadels(planet_id,level,treasury,owner_id) VALUES(977790,1,456,@{godot_capture_owner_player_id}),(977791,1,789,@{godot_capture_owner_player_id}) ON CONFLICT(planet_id) DO UPDATE SET level=1,treasury=EXCLUDED.treasury,owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id;

tests.name: Snapshot exact attacker turns before fault and UI capture

data.sql: SELECT turns_remaining FROM turns WHERE player_id=@{godot_capture_attacker_player_id};

tests.name: Install transactional capture fault for second planet

data.sql: ALTER TABLE planets ADD CONSTRAINT qa_godot_capture_rollback CHECK(planet_id<>977791 OR owner_id=@{godot_capture_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Rollback-target attack fails closed
Injected capture failure rolls back all combat and planet state

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.owner_id=@{godot_capture_owner_player_id} AND p.population=1000 AND p.population_type='COLONIST' AND p.colonists_unassigned=600 AND p.colonists_ore=100 AND p.colonists_org=100 AND p.colonists_eq=100 AND p.colonists_weapons=100 AND p.fighters=50 AND p.ore_on_hand=123 AND p.organics_on_hand=234 AND p.equipment_on_hand=345 AND c.treasury=789 AND s.fighters=100 AND t.turns_remaining=@{capture_initial_turns} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM engine_events WHERE type='player.capture_planet.v1' AND payload LIKE '%977791%') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM engine_events WHERE type='player.attack_planet.v1' AND payload LIKE '%977791%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p JOIN citadels c USING(planet_id) JOIN players a ON a.player_id=@{godot_capture_attacker_player_id} JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=a.ship_id JOIN turns t ON t.player_id=a.player_id WHERE p.planet_id=977791;

tests.name: Remove rollback injection after verification

data.sql: ALTER TABLE planets DROP CONSTRAINT qa_godot_capture_rollback;

tests.name: Wait for ordinary Godot UI capture journey
Godot capture leaves authoritative owner, population and planet assets consistent

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.owner_id=@{godot_capture_attacker_player_id} AND p.owner_type='player' AND p.population=1000 AND p.population_type='SLAVE' AND p.colonists_unassigned=600 AND p.colonists_ore=100 AND p.colonists_org=100 AND p.colonists_eq=100 AND p.colonists_weapons=100 AND p.fighters=0 AND p.ore_on_hand=123 AND p.organics_on_hand=234 AND p.equipment_on_hand=345 AND c.treasury=456 AND (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{godot_capture_attacker_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=54321 AND (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{godot_capture_owner_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=87654 AND (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='corp' AND owner_id=@{capture_corp_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=7777 AND (SELECT quantity FROM sector_assets WHERE corporation_id=@{capture_corp_id} AND asset_type=1 AND sector_id=@{capture_sector}+1)=17 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM engine_events WHERE type='player.capture_planet.v1' AND payload LIKE '%977790%')=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p JOIN citadels c USING(planet_id) WHERE p.planet_id=977790;

tests.name: Attacker fighter losses and single combat event match the approved settlement

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN s.fighters=50 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM engine_events WHERE type='player.attack_planet.v1' AND payload LIKE '%977790%' AND payload LIKE '%"ship_loss": 50%')=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.player_id=@{godot_capture_attacker_player_id};

tests.name: Godot capture player logs out
